confidence_notes: The restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living listings found in web searches, which disagree with each other and are partly dated (Numbeo-based data from 2025, one listing updated May 2026). Beer figures range from about $2 to $5 and I took a typical restaurant price near the middle. The mid-range meal for two is a bounded estimate between a low daily-budget figure and an implausibly high $47-per-meal listing. I found no Essaouira cocktail prices, and only scattered wine-by-the-glass reports of roughly 60 to 70 MAD. Alcohol licensing is limited in Essaouira, so those prices are especially uncertain. I set cocktail and wine from the local relationship to beer. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Moroccan coastal tourist towns. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. July is peak season, so these estimates lean slightly higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Essaouira is a small, tourist-oriented Atlantic coastal city. I used it as a basis in line with Moroccan tourist cities such as Marrakech and Taghazout, with prices a little lower than Marrakech and the Moroccan average according to cost-of-living listings.
